opportunities.title: Complete and correct your business listings
opportunities.found: Your Google Business Profile shows an old address and lists only one service. You have no Bing Places listing, which Copilot and ChatGPT both draw on.
opportunities.action: Update your Google profile with your current address, opening hours and every service you offer, and create a matching Bing Places listing.
opportunities.why: AI tools check these listings to confirm a business is real, local and relevant. Wrong details make them less likely to recommend you.

opportunities.title: Answer your customers' questions on your website
opportunities.found: Your website does not clearly say who you help, what you charge or that you handle self-assessment returns.
opportunities.action: Add a page for each main service, written in plain English, with a short set of common questions and answers, such as fees, deadlines and who it is for.
opportunities.why: AI tools recommend businesses whose websites directly answer the question being asked. Clear, specific pages give them something to quote.

opportunities.title: Build more independent reviews and mentions
opportunities.found: You have 11 Google reviews. The two competitors AI recommends most have 210 and 96.
opportunities.action: Ask satisfied clients for a review after each tax return, and make sure you are listed in trusted directories such as your professional body's register and local business directories.
opportunities.why: AI tools look for signs that other people trust a business. Reviews and mentions on independent sites are among the strongest of these.
